notes.subject: ruakh
notes.rationale: רוחo e šumišwa ka modumo wa Seheberu go ya le D2 — e bolela moya, phefo le go hema ka lentšu le tee

notes.subject: עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו
notes.rationale: Sephuthi se se rare kudu, se bolela mekgwa ya go nagana; diphetolelo tše ntši di re 'thoughts' goba 'plans'

notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Sepedi se nyaka mohlami go hlalosa sebopego sa thwalo

translation: Ruakh ya hae e a ntšhwa, o boela go lerou le hae; ka letšatši leo mekgwa ya gagwe ya go nagana e a hwetša ⟨ke⟩ phoo.

tokens.gloss: mekgwa ya gagwe ya go nagana
